Job evolution explorer

How the O*NET occupations behind University role families changed across 20 O*NET database releases (13.0, 2008 to 31.0, 2026). The page shows measured change at real O*NET update events, a temporally backtested churn model and a role-family watchlist. Public data only, role level only.

Job evolution watchlist: University role families

Bars: mean P(substantive task change at the next O*NET update), with the 10th to 90th percentile band over 60 lineage-bootstrap refits. Click a family to list its roles.

Technology adoption curves

Number of O*NET occupations listing each technology as a technology/software example, by release. Technology examples are in the database files from O*NET 21.0 (2016). From about 2018 O*NET adds examples from job postings in bulk, so curves mix employer adoption with O*NET's collection method.
